channel.title: Dong Xing's Blog
channel.description: Last 10 notes on Dong Xing's Blog

item.title: Quickselect
item.description: Quickselect is an algorithm that finds the k-th smallest element in an array of n numbers a_0,a_1,\dots,a_{n-1} in \mathcal{O}(n) time and \mathcal{O}(n) space.

item.title: Quicksort
item.description: Quicksort is an algorithm that sorts an array of n numbers a_0,a_1,\dots,a_{n-1} in non-decreasing order in \mathcal{O}(n\log n) time and \mathcal{O}(\log n) space.

item.title: Binary Heap
item.description: The Binary Heap is a data structure that maintains a multiset S of numbers by maintaining a complete binary tree.

item.title: Cartesian Tree
item.description: The Cartesian Tree is a data structure that maintains an array of n numbers a_0,a_1,\dots,a_{n-1} by maintaining a binary tree.

item.title: Monotonic Queue
item.description: The Monotonic Queue is a data structure that maintains an array of n numbers a_0,a_1,\dots,a_{n-1} by maintaining S=\{i:i\in\{0,1,\dots,n-1\}\land\forall j\in\{i+1,i+2,\dots,n-1\},a_i\ge a_j\} This requires \mathcal{O}(n) space.

item.title: Kasai's Algorithm
item.description: Kasai’s Algorithm is an algorithm that computes h(0),h(1),\dots,h(n-2) for a string of length n, where h(i)=\left|\operatorname{lcp}\{s_{a_i}s_{a_i+1}\dots s_{n-1},s_{a_{i+1}}s_{a_{i+1}+1}\dots s_{n-1}\}\right| where a_i denotes the starting index of the i-th lexicographically smallest suffix of s, ...

item.title: Knuth-Morris-Pratt Algorithm
item.description: The Knuth-Morris-Pratt Algorithm is an algorithm that computes \pi(1),\pi(2),\dots,\pi(n) for a string s of length n, where \pi(i)=\max\{j:j\in\{0,1,\dots,i-1\}\land s_0s_1\dots s_{j-1}=s_{i-j}s_{i-j+1}\dots s_{i-1}\} in \mathcal{O}(n) time and \mathcal{O}(n) space.

item.title: Manacher's Algorithm
item.description: Manacher’s Algorithm is an algorithm that computes d(0),d(1),\dots,d(n-1) for a string s of length n, where d(i)=\max\{j:j\in\{0,1,\dots,\min\{i,n-i-1\}\}\land s_is_{i-1}\dots s_{i-j}=s_is_{i+1}\dots s_{i+j}\} in \mathcal{O}(n) time and \mathcal{O}(n) space.

item.title: Manber-Myers Algorithm
item.description: The Manber-Myers Algorithm is an algorithm that finds the lexicographical order of the suffixes of a string s of length n in \mathcal{O}(n\log n) time and \mathcal{O}(n) space.

item.title: Z Algorithm
item.description: The Z Algorithm is an algorithm that computes z(0),z(1),\dots,z(n-1) for a string s of length n, where z(i)=\left|\operatorname{lcp}\{s,s_is_{i+1}\dots s_{n-1}\}\right| in \mathcal{O}(n) time and \mathcal{O}(n) space.
